opening.argument: The presentation is a Coinbase system-update event describing an exchange, financial tools, business APIs, and the Base App as product offerings. The speaker says users can trade multiple asset classes and announces direct deposit, unstaking, loans, borrowing, and peer-to-peer payments, while also presenting Coinbase Business, developer APIs, and a generally available app. Those descriptions explain features and services; they do not document a victim interaction, a completed transaction, or a deceptive destination. The material likewise does not establish guaranteed returns, required payment, credential requests, or any transaction outcome. Its promotional financial language and trading or borrowing interfaces remain informational in context, reinforced by the express statement that nothing discussed is intended as investment advice.

citations.quote: First, we launched the Everything Exchange. You can now trade multiple asset classes on Coinbase, equities, prediction markets, millions of crypto assets, token sales, simple derivatives, anywhere at any time.
Today, we announced direct deposit, instant unstaking, Ethereum-backed loans, updates to our borrowed product and a redesigned peer-to-peer payment experience.

The Coinbase business is now out of beta and available to everyone, and we shared a number of updates to our fast-growing Coinbase developer platform with a suite of API is designed to integrate crypto into any app.
Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice.
